# About us

<div class="text-large text-center about-intro">
  <p>Get to know the Finnish Society for Bioinformatics and meet the
     board members.</p>
</div>

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .about-text}

The Finnish Society for Bioinformatics was founded in 2006 with the aim of
bringing together everyone interested in bioinformatics. For almost two decades,
our mission has remained the same: We aim to support research, share the latest
scientific discoveries, and provide opportunities for exchanging ideas and
knowledge.

We organize regular webinars, seminars, and training sessions. We share job
opportunities for our society members and host networking and collaboration
events. Every two years, we proudly recognize outstanding work by awarding the
Best Bioinformatics Thesis Award. Our monthly BioBeers gatherings in Helsinki,
Turku, Tampere, Oulu, and occasionally other locations offer a relaxed way to
meet and connect with fellow bioinformaticians.

Whether you’re an experienced researcher, an early-career student, a research
group, or a company, we warmly welcome you to join our community and be part of
this exciting network of bioinformaticians.

:::
